name: c3
description: Runs the `c3` binary as a read-only reviewer bridge from Claude Code and records each consultation as files (brief, verbatim reply, JSON ledger, findings tracked by id), with per-reviewer thread lineages, a fail-closed provider preflight, a reviewer roster, a routed review panel (detach/status/wait/kick), four engines (Codex, Gemini through agy, Meta Muse through muse, and an OpenRouter/API path through a native http engine), usefulness ratings and a scoreboard, sanitizing packs and explainers, a local code index and telemetry-driven panel routing; a SessionStart hook and three skills (consult, coordinate, setup-providers). Needs the `c3` binary on PATH or CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT-relative, git, and the Codex CLI signed in to ChatGPT or given a [model_providers] table whose env key the user sets.
